sources.title: معرفی رویداد اینوتکس — زیست بوم نوآوری، زیر یک سقف
facts_supplied: 15th edition; largest innovation & technology event in Iran; 100,000+ annual in-person and virtual audience from around the world
goals: empowering entrepreneurs, financing, market entry path, connecting ecosystem players
Pardis Technology Park (techpark.ir) is the exhibition owner/licensee; secretariat run with private-sector companies
permanent supporters: معاونت علمی، فناوری و اقتصاد دانش‌بنیان ریاست جمهوری (isti.ir) و مرکز همکاری‌های تحول و پیشرفت ریاست جمهوری (citc.ir)
Pardis Technology Park founded 1380, 400+ member companies; upgraded to منطقه بین‌المللی نوآوری ایران by cabinet decree in 1403

access routes: shuttle buses from ایستگاه نوبنیاد (بزرگراه بابایی) and ایستگاه تهران‌پارس (اتوبان شهید یاسینی), both via آزادراه تهران–پردیس first exit after the main toll, past Pardis Azad University
virtual exhibition at https://inotex.com/ex
dates 11–14 Shahrivar 1405, hours 14–20 (corroborates FAQ); secretariat Seraj Building Unit 125

sources.title: موضوعات نمایشگاه
facts_supplied: no restriction to a specific technology domain; goal is gathering entrepreneurs and experts for synergy
annual approach reviews latest innovation trends; 2025 trends in three categories: Smart (هوشمندسازی), Digital (دیجیتال), Sustainable Development (توسعه پایدار)

sources.title: اینوتکس چیست — اهداف و ماموریت‌ها
facts_supplied: INOTEX held since 1390 (2011) by Pardis Technology Park with international companies
three goals: investment (domestic & international investors ↔ companies/startups), partnership & collaboration, dialogue & networking
connects cutting-edge tech to large and medium industries, tech-product customers to producers, investors to tech projects and startups
since 1400 (2021) the Pardis Innovation District hosts INOTEX

sources.title: برگزارکننده

upgraded in 1403 by cabinet decree to منطقه بین‌المللی نوآوری ایران so members get special facilities
footer organizer logos: isti.ir, iiid.tech, techpark.ir, asna.ir
